paper.title_en: Bosonic Magic Resources at Quantum Criticality
paper.abstract_en: Non-Gaussianity is a resource for bosonic quantum information processing, providing a necessary ingredient for universal quantum computation in continuous-variable systems. Here we quantify non-Gaussianity in the ground state of the one-dimensional extended Bose-Hubbard model using quantum relative entropy (QRE), a measure determined solely by one-body correlations. The scaling of the QRE with system size reveals quantum phase transitions involving hidden and conventional order. We connect QRE scaling in the weakly interacting superfluid phase to Luttinger-liquid correlations and identify distinct critical signatures in its extensive and subleading contributions. At the Mott-Haldane transition, subtracting the extensive background reveals a pronounced peak in the subleading contribution, providing a clear signature of the onset of hidden string order. At the Haldane-density-wave transition, the extensive contribution to the QRE instead exhibits scaling consistent with Ising criticality. These results establish non-Gaussianity as a probe of many-body criticality, linking bosonic quantum resources to strongly correlated matter.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该文研究扩展Bose-Hubbard模型中非高斯性的量子相对熵标度，属于凝聚态量子临界与量子资源理论，未涉及引力、时空、黑洞、全息对偶或任何引力理论基础课题，与本索引的选题范围无关。
decision.title_zh: 量子临界处的玻色魔法资源
decision.abstract_zh: 非高斯性是玻色量子信息处理的一种资源，是连续变量系统中实现通用量子计算的必要要素。本文利用量子相对熵（QRE）量化一维扩展Bose-Hubbard模型基态中的非高斯性，该度量仅由单体关联决定。QRE随系统尺寸的标度揭示了涉及隐藏序与常规序的量子相变。我们将弱相互作用超流相中QRE的标度与Luttinger液体关联联系起来，并识别出其广延贡献与次领头贡献中不同的临界特征。在Mott-Haldane转变处，减去广延背景后在次领头贡献中显现出显著峰值，为隐藏弦序的出现提供了清晰标志。在Haldane-密度波转变处，QRE的广延贡献反而表现出与Ising临界性一致的标度。这些结果确立了非高斯性作为多体临界性的探针，将玻色量子资源与强关联物质联系起来。
